INSERT INTO AGP.PRF_RESPONSE_ARCHIVE (PRF_RESPONSE_ID,BATCH_ID,RECORD_TYPE,RID,BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT,BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT,STATUS_MSG,INSERTED_DT)
SELECT /*+parallel(4)+*/ 
PRF_RESPONSE_ID,BATCH_ID,RECORD_TYPE,RID,BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT,BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT,STATUS_MSG,INSERTED_DT FROM AGP.PRF_RESPONSE

SELECT /*+parallel(4)+*/ MAX(BATCH_ID) AS BATCH_ID_INITIAL
 FROM AGP.INMCD_PRF_CONTROL
WHERE FILE_TYPE = 'R'
AND FILE_PROCESSED_DT = TRUNC(SYSDATE)

scripts.text:
INSERT INTO AGP.PRF_RESPONSE
(
        BATCH_ID,
        RECORD_TYPE,
        RID,
        BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT,
        BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT,
        STATUS_MSG
)
SELECT  /*+parallel(4)+*/
        @BATCH_ID_Initial, 
        RECORD_TYPE,             
        LTRIM(RTRIM(RID)),
        TO_DATE(BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT,'yyyy/mm/dd') AS BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT,      
        TO_DATE(BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT,'yyyy/mm/dd') AS BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT,  
        STATUS_MSG
FROM AGP.PRF_RESPONSE_IN_FILE_STAGING

UPDATE AGP.INMCD_PRF_CONTROL PRFC
SET PRFC.RECORD_COUNT = (SELECT /*+parallel(4)+*/  COUNT(1) 
                        FROM AGP.PRF_RESPONSE PRFS
                        WHERE PRFS.BATCH_ID = concat(pipeline().parameters.BasePath, '/', @item().name))
WHERE PRFC.BATCH_ID = concat(pipeline().parameters.BasePath, '/', @item().name)
AND PRFC.FILE_TYPE = 'R'

SELECT /*+parallel(4)+*/ MAX(BATCH_ID) AS BATCH_ID_FINAL 
 FROM AGP.INMCD_PRF_CONTROL
WHERE FILE_TYPE = 'R'
AND FILE_PROCESSED_DT = TRUNC(SYSDATE)

EmailMessage_FinalPRF.value: 'Final PRF Response file not received on 04/15/2025'
